concerns.text: "Maximum ensemble size: a limited number of models." – No quantitative bound is given, so compliance cannot be objectively verified.

"Maximum MC Dropout passes: a sufficiently large number of passes to achieve stable estimates." – The phrase “sufficiently large” is undefined; the requirement is not testable without a concrete pass count or convergence criterion.
"Must enforce a hard cap on samples per dataset based on available memory." – The cap is not specified (e.g., number of samples or memory threshold), making the requirement unverifiable.

"The pipeline script (`code/pipeline.py`) must complete without errors on a subset of data." – The size or composition of the “subset of data” is not defined, so success cannot be measured reproducibly.
